text: Grandan Rocks (Japanese: , Guranda no Iwa) are unique collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Sylvalum, in particular near FN Site 402. Four are required for Rocky Research.
Gun Snakes (Japanese: , Surōgan) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Cauldros, in particular east of FN Site 502. Five of them are needed during Material Hunt B.
Gyulalis (Japanese: , Giurari) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Cauldros.

Gugli, the Relentless (Japanese: , Mōtsui no Gūrī) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Suid family. It can be found at level 20 at the northern edge of Janpath Lake in Primordia. It can drop the Suid Fillet needed for Suid Sirloin.
Graham (Japanese: , Gureiamu) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at Central Melville Street in the Commercial District, in a parking lot south of Barista Court.

Griffus, the Tartarean (Japanese: , Kidō no Gurifosu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Insidia family. It can be found at level 49 in Noctilum at Fukai Pass. Killing it is required for segment recon.

Gularth (Japanese: , Gurāsu) are Humanoid enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are bipedal titans made of rock and lava. They exclusively dwell in Cauldros. In battle, they use physical and thermal battle arts. They are similar to Sylooth.

Grex Wisdom Teeth are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Grexes, or for 34 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are one of the required components of Resistance Reducer augments.

Guardian Pugiliths (Japanese: , Gādā Berudero) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Pugilith machines, Ganglion's vehicles, and can be found at level 46 at Badr Basin near FN Site 406 in Sylvalum. Two of them must be defeated during Law and Orders. They can drop the New Cylinders needed for It's-a Mia! and Skell Repair: Cylinder.
Green Simius Manes are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be dropped by the green-haired Simius in Noctilum. Three are required for Extreme Fluffiness.

Grand Cantors (Japanese: , Hai Imupureka, High Cantor) are minor enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Cantor family, and can be found at level 55 at Scholes Battlegrounds, near the watering hole and the bridge leading to Titan's Table, and at level 60 on the M'gando Volcanic Crater in Cauldros.

Gypsy Saltats (Japanese: , Jipushī Sarutāto) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Saltat family, and can be found at level 48-49 in Cauldros at the Capital Wreckage during clear weather.

Grand Vivohasts (Japanese: , Guranto Borunte) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Vivohast family, and can be found at level 43-44 at FN Site 414 and at level 41 on the Sylvalum Searoad in Sylvalum.

Green Blattas (Japanese: , Gurin Buratta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Blatta family, and can be found at level 43 at Badr Stronghold and at level 41-44 under some rock formations at Northern Searoad in Sylvalum.

Guise Blattas (Japanese: , Imāji Buratta, Image Blatta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Blatta family, and can be found at level 34 under the spiked structure at Needle Rock Sandsea south of FN Site 411 and east of FN Site 413 in Sylvalum, where they may replace a Mirage Blatta in their group. They are non-aggressive at night, unlike Mirage Blattas.

Grav Raptor Seidr (Japanese: , Gurabiraputā Basugia) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Seidr machines, Ganglion's Skells type, and can be found at level 47-49 in the skies around FN Site 508 and the Ganglion Weapons Hangar in Cauldros.

HH100: Hierana (Japanese: , HH100: Hehyanu) is a Mission Exclusive Secondary Boss in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a level 50 Definian and is fought in Cauldros's Ganglion Antropolis during the Normal Mission Mia is Missing!. Her arts include Collider (electrical), Jam (electrical), and Maximum Energy (beam). She drops the Container Key which is needed to complete the mission.
HP001: Harriess (Japanese: , HP001: Hariesu) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a Definian who appears in the Ganglion Antropolis in Cauldros during the Normal Mission Definian Downfall.

Gu Ladha (Japanese: , Gu Rada) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a Wrothian, and can be found on the roof of the BLADE Tower in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles. Gu Ladha stands out amongst Wrothians as she has large circular ears, which are said to be adorable and distracting. This has given her horrible self-esteem issues (to the point where she intends to cut her ears off) and driven her to seek solitude wherever possible, avoiding other people so that they will not look at her ears.

The Guard Qmoeva (Japanese: , Gādo Kumūba) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a level 36 grey Qmoeva equipped with a Ganglion Railgun, Boggle Bomb, and Multi Laser. It appears at Primordia's Bedrock Hold during the Affinity Mission Blitzkrieg and must be defeated.
Grand Procession is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Duelist at rank 7.
Gravity Guard is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Galactic Knight at rank 2.

Green Lance Galdr (Japanese: , Gurinransu Garudora) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Galdr machines, Ganglion's vehicles, and can be found at level 43 atop the Lesser Anvil in Sylvalum.

Green Master Galdr (Japanese: , Gurinmasutā Garudora) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Galdr machines, Ganglion's vehicles, and can be found at at level 53 on the easternmost rock structure southwest of FN Site 415, level 54 at Anvil Rock One, and at level 59 above Badr Stronghold in Sylvalum. The Green Master Galdr on the rock structures are dormant until approached, distingished from nearby inactive Galdr by the glowing lights on their weapons.

Guide Eagle Galdr (Japanese: , Gaidoīguru Garudora) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Galdr machines, Ganglion's vehicles, and can be found at level 57 at the O'rrh Sim Watchtowers in Cauldros. They are dormant until approached, distinguished from the nearby inactive Galdr by their weapons and by being noticeably larger.

Guide Raptor Galdr (Japanese: , Gaidoraputā Garudora) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Galdr machines, Ganglion's vehicles, and two can be found at level 50 directly east of Ternion Fork BC, which is located south and south east of Sunset Falls in Cauldros, right above the Unlimited Output Zig. They hover in the air, dormant until approached.

Gun Eagle Galdr (Japanese: , Gan'īguru Garudora) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Galdr machines, Ganglion's vehicles, and can be found at level 51 atop the flat-topped rock structure near Bedrock Hold in Primordia.

Grenade Pizza F (Japanese: , Gurenēdo Piza F) is a Mission Exclusive Secondary Boss in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Human-Made Skell piloted by Powell and is fought at level 35 in Oblivia's Cliffside Camp during Murder Most Foul.
Gravity Boost is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Mastermind at rank 3. Cross and Mia can use this skill.

Gu Ludho (Japanese: , Gu Rado) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a Wrothian who can be found at Ishmael Hills in the Residential District of New Los Angeles during the night, after completing the mission A Challenger Approaches.
The Guardian's Skull is an Appendage Fragment in . It is obtained exclusively from Telethia Plume.
Guardian's Left Wing is an Appendage Fragment in . It is obtained exclusively from Telethia Plume.
The Guardian's Left Plume is an Appendage Fragment in . It is obtained exclusively from Telethia Plume.
The Guardian's Plate is an Appendage Fragment in . It is obtained exclusively from Telethia Plume.
The Guardian's Right Plume is an Appendage Fragment in . It is obtained exclusively from Telethia Plume.
Guardian's Right Wing is an Appendage Fragment in . It is obtained exclusively from Telethia Plume.
The Guardian's Tail is an Appendage Fragment in . It is obtained exclusively from Telethia Plume.

The Guard Monoceroses (Japanese: , Gādo Unikoru) are three Mission Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are level 42 – 44 members of the Monoceros family. They are fought on the cliffs of the Emerian Battlegrounds in Cauldros during My Angel, My Lana.

The Guardian Etherscale is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is obtained from Telethia, the Endbringer in Noctilum during The Nopon Heir, and is needed in order to complete this mission.
HP Rebound is an armor Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It grants a low chance to restore 25 to 500 HP when taking damage.

The Grudge Tersqual (Japanese: , Rakenma Gurajji) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Tersqual family, and can be found at level 56 at the Forgotten Mining Frigates in Cauldros. Defeating it is required during To Serve Nopon as it tries to make a meal out of a Nopon.
Gray Shells are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Petramands, or purchased for 90 Reward Tickets.
Grex Wrecker is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Reclaimers and the primary destination is Oblivia.
Greed is Great is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located at the Integrated Production Plant in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles between Murderess and Cross at night.
The Gray Keycard is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is obtained by defeating the Marnuck Hunter, and is required to complete Professorial.

Green Blatta Wings are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from green Blattas, or for 24 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in I and V Side Attack Plus and PositionDmg.SIDE augments.

Green Crystals are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from crystal-covered Falsaxums, or for 114 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in Reflect Damage Up I and Reflect.DAMAGE-UP I augments.

Green Jacul Wings are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from green Jaculs, or for 72 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in X, XV, and XX Ranged Attack Up and SpecUp.R-ATK augments. Two are needed for The Phantasmagoric Fan.

Green Monoceros Horns are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from green Monoceroses, for 72 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks, or for 25 Material Tickets from the Material Market in . They are components in I and V Melee: Recover HP and M-Auto.HP-RECOVERY augments.

Green Mortifole Feathers are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from green Mortifoles, or for 42 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in Focused Evasion augments.

Green Puffs are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from green Mephites, or for 42 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in Resistance Reducer I and V augments.
Gularthian Flints are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Gularth.

The Grand Lophid (Japanese: , Gurando Rofiru) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Lophid family, and is fought twice at level 36 at Primordia's Shadow Beach BC during The Bug Whisperer.
Grex A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts the silvery shade grex variant dwelling in Primordia. It can be obtained from silver drops from Dieter, the Epicure.

Grex B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a darker shade with spiked snouts grex variant dwelling in Oblivia. It can be obtained from silver drops from Celedonio, the Battle-Tested.
Gularth A is a Holofigure in . It depicts a blue Gularth variant. It can be obtained from Ilithios, the Enlightened in Cauldros.
Gularth B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a red Gularth variant. It can be obtained from Alithios, the Indignant in Cauldros.

It is obtained by completing the Fruits category of the Sylvalum Collectopedia. It is obtained by completing the Curios category of the Cauldros Collectopedia. Grenada Swimwear (Male) is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a male mannequin wearing a complete set of Grenada Galactic Group Casual Wear. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Lakeside Getaway. The Grenada Casual Wear available in game are: ; Head * Bargain Round Sunglasses * Bargain Sunglasses * Limited Round Sunglasses * Limited Sunglasses * Prime Glasses * Prime Sunglasses * Upgraded Snorkel ; Torso * Prime Swimsuit Top ; Legs * Upgraded Swimsuit Bottoms
Great Fisher Koko is a special Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts Koko holding a skeletal fish head. It is obtained by completing the Normal Mission Missing In Action.

Greedy Prone is a Support Mission in . It is unlocked when Chapter 12 is completed, and is intended to make it easier to level up characters by earning EXP, Class EXP, and Battle Points. Enemies do not drop any items in this mission. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.
Gravity Res Up is a ground armor attribute resistance Augment in and that increases gravity attribute resistance. The Skell equivalent is SpecUp.GRAV-RES.
Gravity Attack Plus is a ground weapon attack Augment in and that increases the damage dealt by all gravity-attribute weapons and Arts. The Skell equivalent is AttributeDmg.GRAV.
Gravity Res Down is a stat debuff in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Gravity Res Down increases the damage taken from gravity-attribute attacks.
Gwin's Bodywear is Light Wear torso armor in and . It is manufactured by Sakuraba Industries. It is part of Gwin's initial gear when he joins the team, and cannot be obtained any other way.
H.B.'s Bodywear is Skell Wear torso armor in and . It is manufactured by Sakuraba Industries. It is part of H.B.'s initial gear when he is recruited, and cannot be obtained any other way.
Gravity Resistance is a stat in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It displays resistance to gravity-type attacks.
HB-Rifles are sidearms for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Rail-Gun/M-Laser/E-Bubble types Qmoevas or male Milsaadi.
Grenades are back weapons for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Spine-Cannon/E-Bubble/B-Bomb types Qmoevas or female Milsaadi.
H-Arrows are back weapons for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Titan Missile type Galdrs, Gularth or Sylooth.
HB-Missiles are shoulder weapons for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Titan Missile type Galdrs, Gularth or Sylooth.
HEAT-EDGEs are weapons for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be obtained from Dagahn.

The HOMURA is a weapon for Skells in . It can be obtained as a reward for completing the Time Attack Mission The Wrothian Samurai where the Vasara must be defeated. It is also possible, albeit much rarer, to obtain one from the Vasara boss fight during Chapter 9 (which will not have the listed pre-determined traits).
H.B.'s Glasses are Casual Wear head armor in and . They are manufactured by Grenada Galactic Group. They are part of H.B.'s initial gear when he is recruited, and cannot be obtained any other way.
Gwin's Legwear is Light Wear leg armor in and . It is manufactured by Sakuraba Industries. It is part of Gwin's initial gear when he joins the team, and cannot be obtained any other way.
Gwin's Armwear L is Light Wear left arm armor in and . It is manufactured by Sakuraba Industries. It is part of Gwin's initial gear when he joins the team, and cannot be obtained any other way.
Gwin's Armwear R is Light Wear right arm armor in and . It is manufactured by Sakuraba Industries. It is part of Gwin's initial gear when he joins the team, and cannot be obtained any other way.
H.B.'s Legwear is Light Wear leg armor in and . It is manufactured by Sakuraba Industries. It is part of H.B.'s initial gear when he is recruited, and cannot be obtained any other way.
H.B.'s Armwear L is Skell Wear left arm armor in and . It is manufactured by Sakuraba Industries. It is part of H.B.'s initial gear when he is recruited, and cannot be obtained any other way.
H.B.'s Armwear R is Skell Wear right arm armor in and . It is manufactured by Sakuraba Industries. It is part of H.B.'s initial gear when he is recruited, and cannot be obtained any other way.
H-RARM-ATK3 is Skell arm armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is standard equipment for the [https://xenoblade.wikia.com/wiki/Amdusias_Hades Amdusias Hades] Skell.
H-LEGS-ATK3 is Skell leg armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is standard equipment for the [https://xenoblade.wikia.com/wiki/Amdusias_Hades Amdusias Hades] Skell.
H-LARM-ATK5 is a Skell Wear arm armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X.
H-LARM-ATK3 is Skell arm armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is standard equipment for the [https://xenoblade.wikia.com/wiki/Amdusias_Hades Amdusias Hades] Skell.
H-HEAD-ATK3 is a Skell head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is standard equipment for the [https://xenoblade.wikia.com/wiki/Amdusias_Hades Amdusias Hades] Skell.
H-BODY-ATK5 is a Skell Wear body armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X.
H-BODY-ATK3 is Skell body armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is standard equipment for the [https://xenoblade.wikia.com/wiki/Amdusias_Hades Amdusias Hades] Skell.

uses Anchor Shot]] HP Potions (Japanese: , Kaifuku potto, Recovery Pots) are items and battle mechanics in and . They appear as green phials on the ground during battle. Some Driver Arts, such as Rex's Anchor Shot, or Specials can cause them to drop from enemies they hit. Any ally in battle can pick them up to restore HP to all allies engaged in battle, as well as slightly build the Party Gauge. AI-controlled Drivers will only move to pick up HP Potions if they have at least one healing Blade equipped. Without any healing Blades equipped, they may still unintentionally pick them up.

The Greatspine Boundary (Japanese: , Ōsebone no Kyōkai) is a landmark in . It is located right in the middle of Gormott, though it is considered by maps to be on the left side. It provides access between the two sides of Gormott's upper level, bridging Nocclia Woods and Melnath's Shoulder. There are no enemies here.
Gyro Break is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when using a Megalance.
Grenade Launcher (Japanese: , Gurenēdoshotto, Lit. "Grenade Shot") is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using an Ether Cannon.
Grand Smash (Japanese: , Gurandosumasshu) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using Knuckle Claws.

The Great Void is a location in . It is an abyss in the Cloud Sea that surrounds the World Tree. It came into existence at the end of the Aegis War, and was carved from the Cloud Sea by Ophion in order to prevent travelers from reaching the World Tree. It cannot be visited in gameplay.

Griffoxes (Japanese: , Repādo) are a family of enemies in and They are aggressive fox-like creatures with a similar build to Jagrons, and come in white, black, and silver varieties depending on habitat. These can be found in the Kingdom of Tantal, Empire of Mor Ardain or Temperantia, and Kingdom of Torna respectively.

Growsa Aspar (Japanese: , Gurauzā Angu) are enemies in . They are members of the Aspar family and can be found at level 80 - 82 in the Chansagh Wastes of the Empire of Mor Ardain. Two of them must be defeated to unlock Corvin's level 5 Ictus Battle Skill.
Grebels (Japanese: , Tasuman) are a family of enemies in the . They are burrowing mouse-like creatures with insectoid features, and come in two colors of green.
The Grodd Residential Zone (Japanese: , Guroddo Kyojū-ku) is a Location in . It is located in Torigoth in the Gormott Province, directly under Garagorm's Arch.
The Guardroom (Japanese: , Keibishitsu) is a location in . It is located on the Titan Battleship in the Gormott Province, beside the Starboard Balcony. There is a Treasure Trove here.
The Great Heat Extraction Duct (Japanese: , Netsugen Saikutsu Kyodai Dakuto) is a Location in . It is located on the Upper Level of the Empire of Mor Ardain.

The Gwenith Paddies (Japanese: , Sēsuroa Suiden) are a Location in . It is located just outside Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya, on the sides of the road leading to Funnystone Highway. It can be reached by Skip Traveling to Fonsa Myma Gate and heading northwest.
The Gwendle Repair Dock (Japanese: , Kuvere Senkan Seibijō) is a Location in . It is located on the outskirts of Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya, next to the Gwenith Paddies.

The Greatmaw Rapids (Japanese: , Agito no Hyōryūchi) are a landmark in . They are located at the very front of the Head of Uraya, and lead to the Windpipe Deeps. There is a Treasure Trove here. There are no enemies here except during Would-Be Mercs.
Gullet Pass (Japanese: , Ryū no Kidō) is a landmark in . It is located in the Head of the Kingdom of Uraya, between the Acid Gullet and Jebbas Cavern. There are no enemies here.

The Great Blowhole (Japanese: , Daifunkikō) is a location in . It is located in the Head of the Kingdom of Uraya, between the Sternum Arch and Lake Varna. There are no enemies here except the initial story-exclusive enemy.

The Great Stairway (Japanese: , Daikaidan) is a location in . It is located to the north of the Olethro Ruins in the Kingdom of Uraya. It is a large staircase with water flowing down both sides. The main stairway connects the ruins above to Fonsa Myma below, although the entire stairway extends much further with the Old Pilgrim's Road, past the Sevind Palace Plaza to the Ruins of Fountain Park and eventually the entrance to the Raqura Aquagardens. There are no enemies here. In , the Great Stairway is shown to have collapsed in its entirety.

The Great Creation Cloister (Japanese: , Arusuto Sōsei Hekiga no Daikairō) is a Landmark in . It is located in the Indoline Sanctum of the Indoline Praetorium. It is the place where the mural depicting the creation of Alrest is located.

The Great Pillar Passage (Japanese: , Seidai Retchūrō) is a landmark in . It is located on the Lower Level of the Kingdom of Tantal, directly west of Genbu Drifts, and leads down to the Head of Genbu.

The Grave Robbers' Haunt (Japanese: , Hakaarashi no Tōkutsu-ato) is a location in . It is located on the Upper Level of Spirit Crucible Elpys, between the Underground River Lavi and the Wonder Spring Plaza Ruins. It must be visited during Difficult Decisions. There are no enemies here.

Grian, Wing Area #2 (Japanese: , Daini Tsubasa-ku - Shemesshu) is a location in . It is located in Hardhaigh Palace in the Empire of Mor Ardain, overlooking Alba Cavanich. There are no enemies or NPCs here.
Gyanna (Japanese: , Gyanomu) are a family of enemies in and . They are insectoid with a flower-like tail bulbs, and are similarly sized to Riiks.
Grilled Anchortails are Seafood Pouch items in . They can be purchased at Fishy Fishy in the Argentum Trade Guild.
The Gryff Deeds are Store Deed key items in . They can be purchased at Gryff Butchers in Torigoth in the Gormott Province.
Grass-Smoked Salmons are Seafood Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Tomi Fishmongers in Torigoth in the Gormott Province.
Grumbird Casseroles are Meat Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Bassani Butchers in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
The Griogair Deeds are a Store Deed key item in . They can be purchased from Griogair's Greens in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Grilled Salmon in Herbs are Seafood Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Hanoon Fishmongers in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Grumbird Rice Bowls are Staple Food Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Platini Deli in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal.
Gryff Butchers is a shop in . It is run by Yofan and can be found in Torigoth in the Gormott Province. It is specialized in Meats. It is involved during the quest A Helping Hand.
Griogair's Greens is a shop in . It is run by Urma and can be found in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain. It is specialized in Veggies.
Grapheon is an NPC in . Grapheon is a Tantalese who can be found in the Kingdom of Tantal's Theosoir. Grapheon runs a shop called Biblio Paulio specialized in Literature.

Ground Caterpiles (Japanese: , Guraundo Kyapiru) are enemies in . They are members of the Caterpile family and can be found at level 24-26 at Honeypot Grotto on the Upper Level - Right area in the Gormott Province. Reeking Douglas can summon some level 60-110 Ground Caterpiles in the Brigands' Hideout.
Grass Kapibas (Japanese: , Gurasu Kapība) are enemies in . They are members of the Kapiba family and can be found at level 10-13 on the western shore of Coolley Lake in the Gormott Province.

Gravur Lizards (Japanese: , Gurabaito Rizado) are enemies in . They are Lizards and can be found at level 38 - 43 on the east bank of Coolley Lake on the Upper Level - Right level of the Gormott Province.
Grievous Clive (Japanese: , Ansatsu no Gurīvu) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Jagron family, and can be found at level 94 at the Jagron's Citadel in Temperantia.
Gronta Gyannas (Japanese: , Garuno Gyanomu) are enemies in . They are members of the Gyanna family and can be found at level 21-23 at Minnet Terrace in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Green Cheese Salads are Veggie Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Corcaja Greengrocers in Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago.

Grash Paguls (Japanese: , Gurashio Pagūru) are enemies in . They are members of the Pagul family, and can be found at level 79-81 at the Litharia Snowfield and the Little Banerro Ruins on the Upper Level of the Kingdom of Tantal, and the Genbu Drifts on the Lower Level. They are only found during misty weather.

They are the upgraded version of Mechanized Greaves and Crystal Greaves accessories. The DLC exclusive Staunch Boots accessory offers a stronger instance of this equipment's effect.
